# WebDocument

## Documentation

A remote file which is not stored on Telegram servers.

It is used, for example, for the media of a [`TonNft`](TonNft.md) and for the icon of a
[`TonConnectManifest`](TonConnectManifest.md).

### Parameters

- **`url`** (`str`)
  URL of the file.

- **`mime_type`** (`str`)
  MIME type of the file.

- **`size`** (`int`)
  Size of the file in bytes.

- **`access_hash`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Access hash of the file. It is present if the file can be downloaded through Telegram with
  [`GetWebFile`](../../raw/functions/upload-g.md#getwebfile); otherwise the file must be downloaded directly
  from its URL.

- **`width`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Width of the image or video, if known.

- **`height`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Height of the image or video, if known.

- **`file_name`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Name of the file, if known.
